name: Sandbox
description: A locomotion sandbox in the style of Advanced Locomotion System v4: a mannequin that walks and jogs in eight directions facing the camera, sprints freely, sets off, stops and turns round with their own clips, leans into curves, turns in place when you look away, jumps, falls and lands soft or hard, climbs stairs, with its feet planted and locked by IK on ramps, stairs and bumps. And a car to get into (E by the driver's door) and drive on the vehicle simulation. It crouches (C) with a shorter capsule. And Firing Line's pistol, AK-47 and SAPS-12 shotgun to carry, aim, fire and reload (Q or the wheel, right mouse, left mouse, R), in third person moving on Mixamo's rifle and pistol motion capture (each weapon has its own walks, jogs, crouch, turns and jumps, its recoil on every shot and its reload), or in first person (V) with Firing Line's viewmodels: aiming down the sights, magazines and a reserve, recoil and spread, the shotgun's pellets; their shots raycasts that push what they hit. All of it is the animator, the Character, Controller and Vehicle nodes and a few input-only scripts. Animations: Mixamo. Car model: "Dirty car" by 3D Error 404 (CC-BY-4.0).
